notes.title: Beta Update v.1.0.5
notes.content:
Update notes for InkyPen Beta v.1.0.5.

Feature: Improved Search

 We've improved the searching algorithm so that it handles approximation better. For example searching for "and" or '&' yields same results and other improvements for providing better relevance in search results.
 Changes to some logic so that it is possible to search for comics where their name is just one letter, for example the series 'X'.
 Comic series that only contain one comic is now counted as a Series in the search results.
 Comics of type Issue are now sorted in their own section in search results.
 Performance improvements


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118493/647acfc112a8e840610a39b39614a5e131b1a3e5.png

Important Fixes

 Ducttaped an issue with the Steam Overlay causing rapid flickering on some monitors. Due to how the rendering system for the InkyPen app works together with the Steam Overlay, it is not entirely solveable currently. We've managed to avoid the flickering issue occuring in the part of InkyPen where we are actively using the Steam Overlay, which is the subscription flow. But the issue may occur if the user opens the Steam Overlay manually on other pages in InkyPen currently.
 Fixed an issue where an InkyPen Subscription change event could be uncaught in our system under certain circumstances.
 Added a practical button to flip sorting of comics in a series in series view. Handy when reading Strips!
 Fixed an issue where some series that contains one or more Free comics to read, was not labeled correctly with the Free label.
 If you clear your reading progress or remove comics from My Comics we're now clearing the cache properly so that your client updates correctly.
 Updates for cross-platform logic to inform user that they need to manage their subscription on the platform they first signed up on.
 Fixed a bug that could cause scrolling to not work after exiting the reader.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118493/c44e9ea8798f751b7f53caf46fb5d990db53233f.png

Minor Fixes

 Fixed an issue with the directional arrows in the reader sometimes getting their scaling messed up.
 Mouse drag support for the carousel on the Discover page.
 Improvements to breadcrumb navigation in the carousel on the Discover page.
 Mobile: Fixed an issue with interactive tags in the carousel on Discover not navigating and displaying correctly.
 Mobile: Fixed an issue where rapidly scrolling the carousel on Discover could cause it to disappear.
 Fixed an issue in the reader where switching between reading modes, your reading progress would not carry over.
 Reading mode now carries over correctly when going to the next volume in a series by clicking the next volume button on the endcard.
 Changed wording on the "Start Reading" button to "Read" instead so it's more generic.
 Mobile: Fixed an issue where comics of type Issue were mislabeled on the frontend as "Chapter Null".
 Mobile: Fixed a missing close modal button in the login\signup flow.
 In the credits section on a series, implemented a maximum displayed amount, and folded any additional credits items into a See More button.
 Improved wording in the subscription flow.
 Mobile: Applicable wheels now display View All button.
 Added a fancypants parallax background image in the Account Page. Cozy!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118493/2cb1adc020bf7629fa2affe20d3740a34c0399e3.png

notes.title: Beta Update v.1.0.4
notes.content:
Update notes for InkyPen Beta v.1.0.4.

Feature: New Carousel

 We've made a new Carousel for the top of the Discover page.
 This makes it easier for us to update the carousel with new comics, and we'll be more active in highlighting comics on there going forward.
 The new carousel fixes an issue where the carousel could disappear when the user were below PG in max age rating in parental controls.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118493/124d73ef4dcfcbe9786f7f905f471fa2718ec53d.png

Important Fixes

 Fixed an issue with an expired subscription not being updated correctly.
 Since one Steam account may only have one subscription to InkyPen, linked to an InkyPen account, we've made some logic to notify the user if their Steam user has an InkyPen subscription, but their logged in InkyPen account does not.


Minor Fixes

 Fixed an error message related to payment not displaying correct error message.
 Carousel breadcrumb are now clickable.
 Fixed some specific comics where their volume\issue ordering was incorrect in Series view.
 Fixed scrollbar being visible while the InkyPen splash screen was playing.
 Added a new sorting option "New To Library" in My Comics.
 Fixed an issue causing the viewport to "jump" when collapsing and expanding filter groups in Browse.
 Fixed an issue with the filter groups in Browse needing a scroll down the page to see them all.
 Fixed an issue where if the user cancels the Subscription flow by closing the Steam overlay, the user is now redirected to the Discover page.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118493/c44e9ea8798f751b7f53caf46fb5d990db53233f.png

In The Works

 We're trying to fix the issue with flickering screen when the Steam Overlay is active on certain monitors.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118493/2cb1adc020bf7629fa2affe20d3740a34c0399e3.png

notes.title: Beta Update v.1.0.3
notes.content:
Update notes for InkyPen Beta v.1.0.3.

Feature: InkyPen Subscription

 It is now possible to subscribe to InkyPen on Steam.
 Please note that the subscription is using real money during the closed beta.
 If you decide to subscribe to InkyPen on Steam, we'd love your feedback if you have any issues or something is unclear. Please use our Discord.


Feature: Clean-up functionality in My Comics

 You can now clear reading progress on comics, either one by one or by bulk action.
 You can now remove comics from My Comics, either one by one or by bulk action.


Feature: Rich Presence on Steam & Discord

 When using InkyPen on Steam, your Steam user in your Steam Friends list now displays "Reading Comics".
 When using Discord while InkyPen is running, your Discord profile will display "Reading Comics".


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118493/124d73ef4dcfcbe9786f7f905f471fa2718ec53d.png

Important Fixes

 Fixed an issue causing certain keyboard keys to not function in other applications while InkyPen is open.
 Changing your password flow now requires old password as well.
 "More from this series" section in Product View is now sorting correctly.
 We've updated the Browse section quite a bit, based on feedback during the beta. Thanks!
 Filters in Browse are now inside collapsable regions.
 You can now filter away comics already present in your My Comics in Browse.
 If you use Parental Controls for age rating, it is now clearer in Browse what content is being excluded and why.
 Several things have received a handy descriptive hover tooltip when hovering over an interactable, for example an Author Tag.
 Improved sorting of content in Series in the list of products so that e.g Issues and Volumes are not jumbled together.
 Reading preferences e.g horizontal mode or vertical mode is now saved and applied by default unless a comic overrides it.
 Applying Filters in Browse are now "sticky", meaning that they stay applied while you're browsing comics, and going back to Browse by using the back button or the breadcrumb navigation. The filters are reset if you enter any other major section in InkyPen, for example Discover or My Comics.
 All filters in Browse can be reset using the reset filters button.
 In Search, you can now add comics to My Comics using the quick-add button on thumbnails.
 Browse will now retain pagination when going back to Browse from a Series you were browsing, by clicking the back button or the breadcrumb navigation.
 Improved filters in My Comics.
 Fixed an issue with a Wheel that was displaying incorrect information based on date added to InkyPen.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118493/647acfc112a8e840610a39b39614a5e131b1a3e5.png

Minor Fixes

 Added confirmation message upon successfully changing password.
 Added notification email sent out upon password change.
 Added a close button in the Reader->Volume Select menu.
 Cleaned up language and design in the sign-up flow.
 Better labeling for Series that contains multiple product types, e.g both Volumes and Issues.
 Added a button for quick-sorting content in Series on ascending\descending.
 Error messaging in sign-up flow if the user entered an invalid email that could not be verified.
 You can now quick-add comics to My Comics in the "View All" section of a Wheel in Discover.
 Fixed an issue when reading in Vertical Mode where the "Up Next" modal was partially covered by the Reader Menu.
 Fixed misaligned header text "Search Results" in Search.
 Replaced splash screen video with one with lower volume applied.
 Fixed an issue with cross-platform reading progress.
 Better error messaging when entering incorrect password when changing email address.
 Fixed an issue that could cause the splash screen audio to play when it should not.
 Series view now has a nice subtle background based on the series thumbnail.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118493/2cb1adc020bf7629fa2affe20d3740a34c0399e3.png

notes.title: Beta Update v.1.0.2
notes.content:
Update notes for InkyPen Beta v.1.0.2.

Feature: Quick Add & Remove from My Comics

 You can now add and remove comics to your My Comics using quick buttons when hovering thumbnails in Browse or Discover wheels.
 You can add and remove a Series to My Comics in Series view.
 Comic thumbnails have a marker displayed without hovering if the series is in your My Comics.
 Known Issue: Quick add/remove button not available in Product view. Will be addressed in a future update.
 Known Issue: Quick add/remove button not available in Discover Wheel->View All. Will be addressed in a future update.


Feature: Clickable Tags

 Tags such as Genre Tag (Fantasy, Mystery...) and Author Tags are now clickable in Series and Product view. When clicked, leads to Search or Browse with the filter applied. Sweet!


Important Fixes

 Improved behavior of the menu in the Reader.
 Added infographics for reading direction and reading mode when opening the Reader.
 First page in a volume only shows navigation arrow in the correct reading direction for the comic.
 Reading history will now synchronize correctly cross-platform.
 Fixed a bug that could lead to a crash when using Search.
 Top navigation bar is now persistent and don't reload when switching views, making navigation feel a lot smoother.
 Fixed an issue where certain product types were not visible in the Series Overview modal in the Reader.
 Improved the flow for changing email address, with some added security measures.


Minor Fixes

 Fixed breadcrumb strings on certain product types.
 Series Title is now clickable in the Reader, leading to the Series when clicked.
 If logging in while in the Reader using the side modal, the Reader is now not listening to key input until the modal is closed.
 Updated graphics for the "You're all caught up" modal in the Reader when reaching the end of a Series.
 Fixed scrollbar overlapping in the log in modal.
 Fixed a few comic book thumbnail covers not loading correctly.
 Added toggle functionality for show/hide password in password input fields.
 Very long email addresses now format correctly.
 Fixed an issue where end card modal was not displaying correctly at the end of a free content, reading as unsubscribed user.
 Added the InkyPen splash screen when opening the app on Steam.
 Changed default filters applied in Browse.
 Search result thumbnails are now rounded.
 Added visual hover effects on a lot of components.
 Back button is now available in steps in the sign-up flow.
 Improved design on emails from InkyPen, e.g when verifying user email address.
 Close modal button in Series overview in the Reader.
 Fixed "Free" label in Browse when filtering for Free.
 Fixed a bug where password input modal would close when selecting all of the text with the cursor.
 Series Name in Reader is now clickable and leads to the Series page.


In The Works

 We're working on MacOS version for InkyPen.
 InkyPen Subscription flow for Steam.
 Retain user preferred reading mode unless a comic overrides it.
 Fix some unwanted behavior when reading Strips.
 Functionality for clearing your reading progress and doing edits to your library in My Comics.
 We'll start looking at gamepad support soon. We'll wait with applying more keyboard hotkeys until we've mapped out controls properly, likely doing integration with Steam Input.
 Sticky filters in Browse.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118493/2cb1adc020bf7629fa2affe20d3740a34c0399e3.png

notes.title: Beta Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Update notes for InkyPen Beta v.1.0.1.
No steam client updates, so no patch download necessary.

Feature: Parental Controls

 It is now possible to set Maximum Age Rating in Account. This will filter content in all views based on the maximum age rating to display.
 Newly created InkyPen Accounts defaults to Mature. If your account is older, Maximum Age Rating might be set lower, so please check your setting in Account.
 Known issue: The main carousel in Discover will not display any content if users Max Age Rating is set to anything below Teen. Will be addressed in a future update.


Important fixes
Strips episodes can now be flipped through in the comic reader.
It is now possible to remove content from My Comics by hovering the comic thumbnail and clicking the remove button.
Fixed an issue where after searching for multiple products in Search, Series and Product view would crash.

Minor fixes
Release calendar handles products with no creators without crashing.
New users will receive a welcome email when creating an InkyPen account.
Added a helpful graphic in Browse if your browse results return zero results.
Issues with re-sizing the steam app.
Improvements to breadcrumb navigation in Series or Product view.
Added the links to FAQ and Contact to the logged in sidepanel menu.
Search Results top banner disabled pointer events(fix for widescreens).
Fixed an issue when applying previous search terms multiple times by clicking the previous search terms buttons.
Fixed some bugs related to Parental Controls and age rating filtering.
Log out button is no longer visible when not logged in.
Publishers are now sorted alphabetically in Browse.
Fixed an issue where certain elements in Browse were not clickable on widescreens over a certain boundary.
Removed Alt + Left click functionality on Links.
Fixed many minor bugs.
Frontend visual polish in many views.

We'll be addressing several of the reported issues in the #closed-beta group on Discord. Thank you for the feedback so far!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118493/2cb1adc020bf7629fa2affe20d3740a34c0399e3.png

notes.title: Welcome to the InkyPen closed Beta!
notes.content:
Hello InkyPen enjoyers and welcome to the closed Beta!

The purpose of the Beta is to show off InkyPen early to press, media and influencers, as well as gathering test data from invited people and catching issues before we launch.
We will continuously work on InkyPen for Steam during the Beta, fixing bugs and issues. Please expect some technical issues and such during the Beta as we work on polishing and making InkyPen the best that we can do on Steam.

How to provide feedback
Please join our Discord: https://Discord.gg/inkypen for providing feedback, bug reports and issues. And fun discussions!

General Information

Notice about Subscriptions
At the start of the Beta, subscriptions using real money is not available, only by coupon code that invitees received. We'll roll out the Subscription system during the Beta.

When is the launch date?
We will announce launch date in our channels later, during the Beta period.

Will MacOS or Linux be available?
Currently, we are only supporting Windows.
We want to support MacOS, and possibly Linux going forward, but we need to clear some technical hurdles for those platforms.
We do not expect these platforms to be available during the Beta period.

Will there be content updates to the comics catalogue?
We are not ready to announce these at the start of Beta. But please follow our social media channels or be on our Discord, as we are preparing to announce these soon.

Steam Deck support?
We plan to support Steam Deck fully, and we plan to realize this in a future large update after the Beta period. Currently, it is possible to run InkyPen on Steam Deck with Proton emulation, but it does not support the controller currently, only touch input.

Controller support?
We plan to support controller input devices. At the start of the Beta, controller support is not available.
